title: Prime Minister Harini highlights message of hope and renewal on Easter
byline: In her message to mark Easter Sunday, Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya stated that Easter, devoutly celebrated by Christians to commemorate the Resurrection of Jesus Christ, is a time to extend wishes for a blessed celebration filled with peace, happiness, and blessings.

title: At Easter vigil, Pope Leo urges world not to grow numb to war
byline: Pope Leo led the world’s Catholics into Easter at a Saturday night vigil Mass in St. Peter’s Basilica and urged people not to feel numbed by the scope of the conflicts raging across the world but to work for peace.

title: President Anura calls for peace, love and forgiveness in Easter message
byline: In his Easter message, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has highlighted that Christian devotees in Sri Lanka and around the world mark Easter Sunday with deep reverence, commemorating the Resurrection of Christ as a symbol of hope, renewal, and compassion.

title: Russian attack on Ukraine market kills five
byline: A Russian drone attack on a market in southern Ukraine has killed five people and injured 21, including a 14-year-old girl, the prosecutor general’s office says.

title: Opposition Leader Sajith calls on nation to uphold peace, truth and unity this Easter
byline: In his Easter message, the Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa highlighted that Easter is a sacred occasion symbolizing hope, resurrection, and new beginnings for society, extending warm wishes to the people of Sri Lanka.

title: Fairly heavy rainfall expected in parts of the island today
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Southern, Uva, Eastern and Northcentral provinces after 2.00 p.m, today (05), the Department of Meteorology said.

title: Trump says Iran military leaders killed in Tehran strike
byline: US President Donald Trump said on Saturday (local time) that ‘‘many’‘ of Iran’s military leaders were killed in a huge strike on the Islamic republic’s capital.

title: Cardinal Ranjith urges to pray for world peace in Easter message
byline: Speaking during the main Easter Mass, His Eminence Malcolm Cardinal Ranjith emphasized that world peace has been shattered, and all of humanity is suffering due to one individual’s desire to dominate the whole world.

title: Transport, freight fares skyrocket by 65 per cent in Pakistan
byline: A massive surge in petroleum prices has triggered an unprecedented hike in passenger and goods transport fares across Pakistan, with increases ranging from 20 to 65 per cent, Dawn reported.

title: 12-hour water cut in Homagama today
byline: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has announced that water supply in the Homagama area will be suspended today from 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., lasting a total of 12 hours.

title: GMOA continues its ongoing strike today
byline: The strike initiated by the Government Medical Officers’ Association (GMOA) continues today (05).

title: New ‘Lord of the Rings’ movie from Stephen Colbert and his son in development at Warner Bros.
byline: Warner Bros. has revealed that Stephen Colbert and his son are developing a brand new ‘‘Lord of the Rings’‘ movie. The announcement came Tuesday night via the studio’s various social media accounts.

title: US service member missing after Iran shot down fighter jet has been rescued
byline: A U.S. service member who has been missing since Iran shot down a fighter jet has been rescued, President Donald Trump wrote in a social media post early Sunday.

title: 12-hour water cut in Padukka area due to low reservoir levels
byline: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has announced a 12-hour water cut in the Padukka area and its surroundings, from 8:00 p.m. today (05) until 8:00 a.m. tomorrow (06).

title: Two Chinese nationals arrested with cigarettes worth over Rs. 3.63 mln at BIA
byline: Two Chinese nationals have been arrested at Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) for attempting to illegally smuggle a large consignment of cigarettes into the country.

title: 31 arrested over illegal fuel hoarding in island-wide raids within a month
byline: A total of 31 individuals have been arrested over the illegal hoarding of fuel during raids conducted across the island over the past month, according to police.

title: Kuwait says Iranian drones strike oil sector complex, power, government sites
byline: Kuwait Petroleum Corporation said a fire broke out in its Shuwaikh oil sector complex, which houses the oil ministry and KPC headquarters, after a drone attack, the Kuwaiti state news agency reported early on Sunday.

title: Health Minister assures solutions to GMOA’s concerns
byline: Minister of Health Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa stated that the government has the capacity to resolve all issues.

title: 65-year-old motorcyclist killed in road accident in Kadawatha
byline: A 65-year-old man has died following a road accident in the Indigahamula Junction area along the Kandy–Colombo main road in Kadawatha.

title: Island-wide fuel station owners to hold silent protest tomorrow
byline: Filling station owners across the island have announced a silent protest to be held tomorrow (06) from 9:30 a.m. in front of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC), citing several unresolved issues, according to the Fuel Distributors’ Association.

title: Over 900 arrested in island-wide anti-drug raids
byline: A total of 906 individuals have been arrested during operations carried out yesterday (04) under the ‘‘Nation United - National Drive’’ campaign aimed at eradicating narcotics from the country.

title: Advisory issued for severe lightning
byline: An ‘Amber’ advisory has been issued by the Department of Meteorology for severe lightning in the Central, Sabaragamuwa, Uva, Southern and Northcentral provinces, and in Ampara district.

title: GMOA claims doctors applied for post-internship appointments due to intimidation
byline: The Government Medical Officers’ Association (GMOA) claims that junior doctors applied for post-internship appointments due to pressure and threats allegedly exerted by the Ministry of Health.

title: Iranian media claims ‘several US aircraft destroyed’ in Isfahan, denies success of pilot rescue operation
byline: Iranian state media has shown wreckage of a US C-130 aircraft that reportedly took part in the rescue of a downed fighter pilot in southern Iran.

title: Warm weather advisory issued for most parts of the country
byline: The Department of Metrology has issued a warm weather advisory for Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern, Eastern, North-western, Northern and North-central provinces and Monaragala District for tomorrow (06).

title: Trump threatens to hit Iran infrastructure on Tuesday if Strait remains blocked
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump said in an expletive-laden social media post on Sunday that the United States will target Iran’s power plants and bridges on Tuesday if the Strait of Hormuz ⁠is not reopened.

title: GMOA says ExCo to decide on continuing strike tomorrow
byline: The Government Medical Officers’ Association (GMOA) says that the strike action launched by government doctors will continue until 8.00 a.m. tomorrow (06).

title: China to provide shipment of refined fuel to Sri Lanka
byline: The government of China has agreed to provide a shipment of refined fuel to Sri Lanka, according to the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC).

title: ‘Not here to do politics’: Sri Lankan diplomat clarifies meeting with Puducherry fishermen
byline: Deputy High Commissioner of Sri Lanka to Southern India in Chennai Ganesanathan Geathiswaran on Sunday (April 5) rejected claims he took part in a meeting with fishermen hosted by any political party.

title: National QR payment promotion programme to be launched tomorrow
byline: The service charge levied on merchants for all LankaQR transactions up to Rs. 5,000 will be completely removed with effect from tomorrow (06), according to the President’s Media Division (PMD).

title: Litro Gas prices increased
byline: The Litro Gas Company has announced an increase in the prices of domestic LP gas cylinders with effect from midnight today (05).

title: ‘Good chance’ of deal being reached tomorrow, Trump tells US media
byline: US President Donald Trump has repeated his threats to Iran over the course of several posts on social media and in comments to US and Israeli outlets.

title: FM Vijitha Herath outlines plans to normalize fuel supply and working days
byline: Sri Lanka’s Foreign Affairs Minister, Vijitha Herath, stated that nine fuel tankers are scheduled to arrive in the country during the month of April.

title: LAUGFS Gas also increases prices
byline: LAUGFS Gas PLC has announced a revision of domestic LPG cylinder refill prices, effective from midnight today (05).
